profile.summary: Self motivated person, who has many goals that I will accomplish.

positions.title: Lead Escalation Software Engineer
positions.description:
A code field medic.
Track down high priority bugs and resolve them.

positions.title: Full Stack developer
positions.description:
Backend: Java with a Spring framework and a Sql database
frontend: AngularJS framework with HTML5

Worked on grouping algorithm for 3000-4000 missionaries based on gender, language, duration of stay, destination, and arrival. This would sort them into companionships (one to three missionaries) then in districts (three to four companionships), then it would group them into a zone(three to four districts). This would assign them to class rooms, layout their entire daily schedule for their duration of their stay which could be up to six weeks.

Have helped on scheduling app which allows missionaries to request specific time with tutors. If tutors were requested specifically, they would be notified via text and or email. If tutor is unable to attend the specific time or after twenty four hours they hadn't accepted the appointment, other tutors were then notified and able to sign up.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Class was taught in C++

Instructed 6 to 7 hour long class weekly, in which I would teach concepts and implementations of basic programming concepts such as object oriented programming to data structures to 25 - 40 students.  I would prepare a 45 min long lesson that would be pertinent to the students' current homework, then the last fifteen minutes I would answer specific questions.

During time i wasn't teaching i would be helping individual students with specific problems, grading tests or helping to develop test drivers for students' homework and tests.
